notes.title: Get on board. THE LIQUID JET is out.
notes.content:
Join us in a new, terminally strange, yet strangely sweet flight into the unknown...

Have you ever had a bad trip in a warehouse rave in the forest?
If not, now it's your chance.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45282505/0c7ee80deb241b24757d61bfb8ca9ab0fb551b70.jpg[/img]

Play as Mae, who visits a rave with her friends, only to get trapped inside what morphs to be a liminal dreamscape where everybody seems to have disappeared.

Or have they..?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45282505/a9c0d991bf3018f1f2486af720b4deef8a6bf331.jpg[/img]

See for yourself and enjoy the ride!

notes.title: The Liquid Jet is flying off to Dreamcast!
notes.content:
Fasten your seat-belts, and prepare to take part in our new flight towards bringing our upcoming psychedelic adventure [b]The Liquid Jet[/b] to the iconic Sega Dreamcast Console,
which marks the first time that a DC port is happening to any Unity game, ever.
So cheers to that!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/P4PmbpP.png[/img]

The man behind the port is [b]skmp[/b], also responsible for the recent DC ports for GTA 3 and Vice City (aka [b]"The impossible port"[/b]), using some of the same (self made) tech, as well as new ones.

As the Dreamcast has a very active homebrew scene, we hope to be partnering with a publisher for a full, physical release, if it all goes well!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/MOUCKOG.png[/img]

And as for the [b]Steam release[/b], it's coming [b]sooner than you think[/b] ;)

[img] https://i.imgur.com/i87LQ4b.png[/img]

notes.title: THE LIQUID JET demo is out
notes.content:
Hello fellow [i]weirdos[/i]!

The demo for [b]The Liquid Jet[/b] is now out for Steam Next Fest!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/RvyqEsb.gif[/img]

It is an atmospheric, offbeat but dreamy night's tale of a girl going to a warehouse rave party with her friends, where she'll go to experience a long, profound bad (or maybe more like weird?) trip.

It is drenched in equal doses of nostalgia, psychedelia, eeriness and fun. 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/7GIgkgO.gif[/img]

Get into it.
Get immersed.
Get liquid! <3
